title: Lew42 v2: Tokens page built after Scale, with equal columns and 500 SM labels

owner_note.text: The Tokens page shows every Scale, Colors, Scheme and Surface value as a table, plus a stretch strip per mode, a Scheme strip and the styles. Its two columns now end level, because a "Scale modes" table (each mode's width, its range and the three core sizes) fills the old gap. Every label now reads 500 SM. The alternative was to swap strips between the columns, which only moves the gap to the other side.
